entries.zh: 尚且（让步递进连词：尚且如此，何况…）；更何况
entries.en: still; even so (concessive: 'even so—how much more')

entries.zh: 尚且（让步递进连词：尚且如此，何况…）；更何况
entries.en: still; even so (concessive: 'even so—how much more')

entries.zh: 何但：岂止；不只（比较递进：岂止…更…）
entries.en: not only; why only (comparative 'how much more so')
how much more so; let alone

entries.zh: 何况；况且（「兼」义为更加上）
entries.en: how much more so; moreover
entries.notes: H 栏 [疑:無/兼]：M 作 quiam，無读 bô 不合，兼读 kiam 相合，取兼；释义据 L 栏 quanto mas。

entries.en: moreover; besides
and moreover; besides
entries.notes: H 栏 [疑:無/兼]，M quiam 指向兼(kiam)；L 栏作 quanto mas comparando。

entries.en: moreover; all the more
entries.notes: H 栏 [疑:無/兼]，M quiam 指向兼(kiam)；与上条又兼互证。

entries.zh: 况今：如今更甚（前置递进连词）
entries.en: how much more now; and moreover, now
entries.notes: L 栏 para q. ante. 为缩写，推作 para que anteceda（前置连词）之注，句意存推断。

entries.zh: （已）有多少；多久（「了几」问数量、时数）
entries.en: how much (already)? how long?
entries.notes: L 栏 q[残]abo 残缺、M 栏 liau xoa, xoa iu 有重复与未定字符，语义仅据 quanto aura 与 H 了几 推定。

entries.en: how much is lacking? how much short?
how much is owed? how much short?
how much is it worth?

entries.zh: 值多少钱；共值几个数（值几数）
entries.en: how much does it come to? what amount is it worth?
what price is it worth?

entries.zh: 贴到多少；额外再加多少（买卖中在价上加几何）
entries.en: how much does it run to on top? how much extra?
entries.notes: L 栏为交易习语 quanto anda de encima，义取『在价上再加几何』，与 H 贴到几、M piap cau xoa 相合，唯句意本有伸缩。

entries.en: how much? more or less (quantity)
entries.notes: L 栏末尾 [疑:opoço/oposo] 难辨，然 quanto mucho 之义明确，不影响本条。

entries.zh: 多少；几多（M 栏 chey chio 即济少，亦训多少）
entries.en: how much? how many (more or less)
entries.notes: L 栏 [疑:opoço/oposo]；M 栏 chey chio 即济少(tsē-chió)，与多少互训，可作旁证。

entries.zh: 有多重；重几何（称重之问）
entries.en: how heavy is it? how much does it weigh?
entries.notes: M 栏 [疑:pang/tang]，tang(tāng) 即重字，合 H 有幾重。

entries.en: how long (a time)?
how many tens of thousands (i.e. a very long time / very many)
entries.notes: H 几万与 L 栏 tiempo largo 为夸饰对应，非确数，取『极多极久』之义。
